events.title: U.S. Dollar Climbs Amid Rising Expectations Of Fed Rate Hike
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value moved higher on Wednesday with market participants pricing in a tighter monetary policy by the U.S. Federal Reserve following yesterday's inflation numbers, hawkish comments by the central bank officials, and the ongoing U.S.-Iran standoff.

events.title: European Markets Finish Broadly Higher On Wednesday
events.description: The major European markets extended recent gains on Wednesday with an eye towards hitting fresh record closing highs. The markets were in the green all day, opening higher and then fading a bit before rallying to finish at daily highs.

events.title: FTSE 100 Rebounds
events.description: The FTSE 100 benchmark rebounded on Wednesday amidst a surge in technology shares. A spike in crude oil prices bolstered energy stocks. Anxiety ahead of GDP update on Thursday limited gains.

events.title: CAC 40 Extends Winning Streak
events.description: A rally in global stock markets powered by the surge in technology shares helped the CAC 40 index to extend its winning streak.

events.title: Siemens Energy Gains On Strong Q4, Positive Outlook, Dividend Hike, €9 Bln Buyback
events.description: Shares of Siemens Energy AG were gaining around 8 percent in the German trading after the company reported Wednesday significantly higher profit in its fourth quarter with revenue growth, and issued positive outlook for fiscal 2027 and ahead. The German energy technology firm also announced significantly higher dividend and up to an additional €9 billion share buyback program.

events.title: DAX Extends Gains On Wednesday
events.description: Lifted by the momentum in technology stocks, the DAX benchmark is close to recording a three-day gaining streak. Positive earnings scorecard also supported market sentiment.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rallies Amid Fed Rate-hike Bets
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation statistics increased anticipation that the Federal Reserve will raise borrowing costs next month.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Hit Eight-month High Amid Sharp Fall In Oil Prices
events.description: Indian shares rose sharply on Wednesday to hit an eight-month high, with investor sentiment boosted by continued foreign fund inflows, a moderation of the AI trade, and a retreat in crude oil prices to two-month lows on hopes for a de-escalation in the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

events.title: Gold Steadies After Sharp Selloff
events.description: Gold prices were a tad higher on Wednesday, after having tumbled in the previous session on concerns over rising inflationary pressures and expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

events.title: Oil Prices Rebound From Two-month Low
events.description: Oil prices traded higher on Wednesday after a two-day decline as fresh tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz raised concerns over global oil supplies.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher As AI Concerns Ease
events.description: European stocks surged toward a fresh record on Wednesday, with investor sentiment underpinned by steadier oil prices, solid corporate earnings and renewed enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade.

events.title: Asian Shares Mostly Higher As Chip Stocks Extend Rebound
events.description: Asian stocks ended mostly higher on Wednesday, even as stronger-than-expected U.S. jobs data bolstered the case for further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes over the coming months.
